name: print-social-red-duotone-music-artist-title-card
title: Red duotone artist portrait with chunky white title
whatItIs: A cover with a red-tinted photo of a man in tinted glasses under a bold red overlay with torn shapes, overlaid by a stacked heavy white title 'BAGUN CINHA'.
whatItMeans: Loud, rhythmic and youthful; red heat and thick type create a street-culture punch.
techniques: Tint a photo with one saturated colour and overlay an expressive shape.
Stack a title in a heavy rounded-blocky face across the centre.
Let the face peek above the type for human contact.
Add rough cut-out edges to the overlay.

vocabulary.definition: A photo coloured with one strong hue.
A name set on multiple lines as a block.
A rough-edged cut-out overlaid on an image.
